payload.name: Banner Blindness
payload.fact: Banner blindness is a phenomenon where users tend to disregard or ignore advertising banners while performing focused tasks (such as reading news) on web pages, often attributed to attentional filter adjustments and task type, with banners being noticed more frequently during low-target-detail tasks.
payload.boundary: Observed during focused tasks and in online media/shopping websites; effect may not hold during free browsing; studies suggest it is not necessarily a perceptual load effect, and task type significantly affects ad visibility.
